    • BinarySearchTree

      public BinarySearchTree(T[] elements)
      Quick constructor to create a BST with an initial set of elements. The resulting BST is formed by inserting the elements in order, according to usual BST insertion rules.
      Parameters:
      elements - Array of elements to insert into the tree.

  • Method Details

    • find

      protected IPosition<T> find(IPosition<T> start, T value)
      Find a node in the tree that contains a particular value.
      Parameters:
      start - The node to begin the search from (to search an entire tree, begin at its root).
      value - The value to search for.
      Returns:
      The internal node that contains value, if it is contained in the tree. If value is not contained in the tree, returns the external node that the search terminated at.
